series_label: Antenatal care 4+ visits - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider (Nigeria, total: all wealth quintiles, residence, mother's education)
source_or_custodian: UNICEF (dataflow UNICEF/MNCH/1.0). Data sources by year: DHS 2003, DHS 2008, MICS 2011, DHS 2013, MICS 2016-2017, DHS 2018, MICS 2021, DHS 2023-2024
status_or_notes: Observation status: Reported for all values. Survey years only; no data for the other years in 2000-2025. Each value is placed at the end of fieldwork. The 2024 value (DHS 2023-2024) carries the footnote 'CRAVE 2024'.
definition: Antenatal care 4+ visits - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider
